name: sleek-line-cursor
title: Sleek Line Cursor
blurb: Colorful trailing lines follow the cursor with spring physics.
description: A canvas-based cursor trail effect using spring-physics simulation. Multiple trailing lines follow mouse/touch position with wave-based HSL color animation.
use_when: A full-page interactive effect for portfolios or creative experiences.
avoid_when: When you need low CPU usage or minimalist interactions — the effect runs continuously and redraws every frame.
a11y: Purely decorative effect. Uses pointer-events-none; interactions pass through. No keyboard interaction.
